_about: The cadres Cadre ships with. Each is a whole cadre minus its folders: a machine adds those itself (pipeline.py project set <project> --dir <folder> --group <cadre>). On each daemon start, runnerlib/cadres.py seed_defaults adds any cadre listed here that this machine has never been given, once; archive one and it stays archived. Fields are a project record's (runnerlib/projects.py) without dirs, group, archived or context, plus kanban: true, which hands this machine's kanban board to the cadre if no cadre owns it yet.
